title: Matched-exposure coseismic landslide transfer benchmark
description: Experiment code, frozen data manifests and splits, machine-readable metrics, bootstrap and interval routines, and audit reports for a retrospective, region-held-out benchmark of coseismic landslide segmentation under cross-event domain shift. The archive covers the two-architecture matched-exposure benchmark, the four-backbone replication of the matched-exposure contrast, the multi-seed calibration diagnostics, the tile-level background false-alarm diagnostic, and the two negative controls on source resolution and evaluation scale. Image data and derived annotations are not redistributed and remain governed by their original licences.
